concept: EKS: IRSA — IAM roles for pods via OIDC provider
tests: Mechanism that gives individual EKS pods their own scoped AWS permissions.
expected: IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA): a service account is linked to an IAM role via the cluster's OIDC provider. Triggers: "pods get scoped AWS permissions", "service accounts".
why_not: A shared node instance profile gives all pods the same broad permissions; access keys in Kubernetes secrets are long-lived; a NAT gateway has nothing to do with IAM.
